context: Saito advises Yuki on health after childbirth.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: medical advice; vocabulary (ゴミ/袋/育児/体重/階段) in natural home.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 育児が忙しくて、運動できません。
lines.en: Childcare keeps me busy; I can't exercise.
lines.style: tired office woman voice, soft warm earnest delivery throughout

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 階段の上り下りも、良い運動ですよ。
lines.en: Going up and down stairs is good exercise.
lines.style: calm doctor voice, soft warm reassuring measured clarity throughout

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 体重が、少し増えてしまって。
lines.en: My weight has gone up a little.
lines.style: concerned office woman voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 育児の合間に、軽く動きましょう。
lines.style: gentle doctor voice, soft warm caring clarity throughout

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: ゴミ出しも、いい運動ですか?
lines.en: Is taking out the trash good exercise too?
lines.style: curious office woman voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: ええ、ゴミ袋を運ぶのも運動です。
lines.en: Yes, carrying the trash bag is exercise too.
lines.style: clear doctor voice, soft warm measured clarity throughout

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 階段を使って、体重を戻します。
lines.en: I'll use the stairs to get my weight back.
lines.style: resolved office woman voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 育児も体も、無理なく続けて下さいね。
lines.en: Keep up both childcare and your body without strain.
lines.style: warm doctor voice, soft warm caring closing clarity throughout
